notes: No more debuffs

history.title: No more debuffs
notes: Every skier's debuff is gone: they only have their perk and their ability now
Grandfather can do tricks like everyone else again; Russian's shield returns at its old pace

history.title: Russian fix
notes: Russian: only his shield got the debuff (it comes back much later); lane changes are 15% slower again and jumps are normal
Launcher 1.2 always fetches a fresh changelog

history.title: Fair prices
notes: Prices now follow what an item really does (no more one big rise): looks and small perks cost little
Strong game-changers stay expensive: thermos, wax, mittens, scarf, trail mix, sled; the strongest need silver or gold tickets
Many cosmetics and trails are cheaper (trails 1000, gold parts 4000, surf board 4300)

history.title: Russian and Grandfather
notes: Grandfather: two tricks off ramps and cliffs, the third is his signature move, three at most

history.title: Candy canes
notes: Every skier can be bought with candy canes alone (no cookies), or with cookies + candy as before
Story skiers (Penguin, Otter, ...) are only met on their mountain; you still buy them in SKIERS
The game writes a small economy_log.csv (one line per run) so prices can follow real play
Debug check for buttons and text that do not fit (--uicheck)

history.title: Open Beta
notes: Open beta!
4 new skiers: Flamingo, Dachshund, Kangaroo, Octopus Diver (own boards, own perks and abilities)
Soft new music that stays behind the sound effects
Tickets in bronze, silver and gold: far mountains pay better, some items cost tickets
Skiers cost cookies and candy; upgrades and game-changing items cost much more
Revive with candy only in Endless; Mochi revives once per run
Own pair of skis for Penguin, Gingerbread, Yeti, King Cookie; Snowman rides his saucer
Tricks: press up again in the air and hold; moves change with what you jump
Jumping a snowball from behind gives stamina; conveyors push; thin ice cracks and breaks
Rock rows never wall off the whole road

history.title: Save slots
notes: 3 save slots
Boards fit every skier
Calmer aurora
Pets leave your tracks
